Q201.why: Ideal-diode FET, first in the chain beside J910 (D14-2 B): sources on VBAT_IN to the west, tab VBAT_D facing the shunt. 17.2 mm of 60 A copper from J910's pad.

Q202.why: Second ideal-diode FET, in parallel with Q201 and mirrored under it so the two share the VBAT_D corridor equally. Tab under the GND bar with tented vias (D01).

Q203.why: Load-disconnect FET, after the shunt: drain VBAT_Q2D faces west to the corridor, sources VBAT_PROT east from x 161.4, where the In2/In3 planes start. Rotated 180° so its sources face the outputs.

Q204.why: Second load-disconnect FET in parallel with Q203, mirrored under it; same reasons.

U201.why: LM74910H just north of the shunt: S1 to R209 6.3 mm, R209 to CS+ (pin 20) 4.6 mm, S2 to CS- (pin 19) 2.6 mm (LM74910H 9.5.1: Kelvin sense). Cost of the re-order: DGATE to Q201/Q202's gates 21.2/26.3 mm and HGATE to R202 23 mm (D04 had 6–9 mm).

U202.why: INA228 beside U201 on the shunt: IN+ 5.2 mm and IN- 0.9 mm from the sense pads (INA228-Q1 10.1: Kelvin connections, short and matched).

C214.why: U202's 100 nF VS bypass, moved to F.Cu directly over pin 6 (0.06 mm pad to pin, a via in between): south of U202 is the shunt and east is the VBAT_Q2D corridor, so the bottom side had no place nearer than 7.8 mm (INA228-Q1 10.1).

R209.why: CS+ series resistor between S1 and U201 pin 20, 2.3 mm from U201.

C212.why: CS filter capacitor across CS+ / CS-, 5.3 mm from pin 20: the shunt and U201 leave no closer bottom-side spot outside the via corridors (D04 had it at the pin).

C213.why: ISCP filter capacitor, 6.0 mm from pin 18; slow node.

R202.why: HGATE series resistor at Q203's gate (1.1 mm), so the long HGATE run from U201 is on the resistor's U201 side; Q204's gate 14.1 mm.

C209.why: Charge-pump capacitor (CAP to VS), 1206, north of U201 off the FET bodies; 7.5 mm to pin 23 because CAP faces the shunt (D04 had 4.5 mm). No legal closer pose on either side of U201 outside the corridors.

R210.why: RISCP, 1.3 mm from the shunt's VBAT_D end and 1.8 mm from pin 24. 383 Ω once the schematic change lands (D14-1 A).

R208.why: ILIM resistor, 4.8 mm from pin 11. 26.7 kΩ once the schematic change lands.

C211.why: TMR timing capacitor, 6.5 mm from pin 9; slow node.

R204.why: UVLO divider, top, 7.4 mm from pin 4; the divider string sits together north-west of U201.

R207.why: OV divider bottom resistor, 9.2 mm from pin 5.

C210.why: BATT_MON filter capacitor at the divider string.

R203.why: FLT_L pull-up to 3V3_MAIN, 3.9 mm from pin 12.

C202.why: HGATE gate capacitor beside R202 and Q203's gate, 3.1 mm.

C201.why: VBAT_IN decoupling on F.Cu over Q201's sources, 0.4 mm.

C208.why: VBAT_D decoupling on F.Cu over U201's VS pins 22/24.

C203.why: VBAT_PROT decoupling on F.Cu over U201's OUT pins 15/16, 1.3 mm.

C204.why: VBAT_PROT decoupling on F.Cu at U201 pin 16 and U202 pin 8.

C205.why: VBAT_PROT 4.7 µF bulk beside Q203/Q204's sources, 4.1 mm, where the planes are fed.

RT201.why: Shunt NTC, against the shunt's south edge to read its temperature.

TP201.why: VBAT_IN test point at Q201's sources.

TP202.why: VBAT_D test point at the shunt's F1 end.

TP203.why: VBAT_Q2D test point at the shunt's F2 end.

TP204.why: VBAT_PROT test point at Q204's sources.

TP206.why: BATT_MON test point at the divider string.
